name: Indigen World staff correspondence
status: integration-contract; no separate staff assistant is connected
permissions: Authenticated admin, existing App Check policy, owner-scoped private drafts

steps: save the supplied structured letter and optional email introduction
return links.docx as Download Word and links.pdf as Download PDF
printLetter.sideEffects: Private document generation only; no email or physical print job

steps: present recipient, email body and exact PDF for human review
send with id, version, revision and reviewed:true
sendLetter.retryPolicy: Reuse the reviewed version delivery key. Never automatically resend accepted, sending or unknown deliveries.

contentPolicy: Heritage Frame is the default. Preserve supplied message meaning and identities. Never invent addresses, signatures or commitments.
